Gene–pathway network of over-dominant and under-dominant genes associated with lipid and energy metabolism and meat quality

Gene–pathway network of over-dominant and under-dominant genes associated with lipid and energy metabolism and meat quality. This bipartite network illustrates the relationships between KEGG pathways (nodes in gold) and genes classified as over-dominant (blue) or under-dominant (red) based on heterosis-related expression patterns
